tailMarker.note: Earliest marker-eligible species is the booster Caprylyl Glycol @10 (eligible because preservatives Benzoic Acid @14 and Benzyl Alcohol @18 are co-declared). E13 establishing-species limb passes (Cetearyl Alcohol @2, SAPDMA @3, IPM @4, Cetyl Esters @5, sunflower @6, avocado @8, shea @9 all outrank @10). Third limb (E2) FIRES via the booster-above-preservative reading: the marker species itself is a booster declared above the preservative it is only permitted to boost (@10 vs Benzoic Acid @14) — this ordering involves the marker species, so the round-2 scope note does not exempt it. Independently, Parfum @19 is the LAST entry behind its own declared allergens Linalool @16 and Coumarin @17 — per the E2 application note a Garnier-style house listing convention, so Parfum carries no concentration position and cannot serve as a fallback marker. Conservative reading is final: unresolved, tail_marker_unresolved.

conditioning_level.rationale: S1 fails on the full list: a single cationic species (Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine @3), so `high` is unreachable whatever the boundary. S2 holds on rank alone (Cetearyl Alcohol @2) and S3 holds on early lipids (Isopropyl Myristate @4, Cetyl Esters @5) without relying on the marker, so `low` is also unreachable; S2+S3 without S1 reads `moderate`. Confidence is capped at `moderate` by the unresolved marker (§3.1.1 consequence 3; §9.1 material counter-signal (a) would anyway bar `high`).

weight_potential.rationale: The only R4b heavy lipid is Shea Butter @9, one rank before the nominal marker @10; with a plausible marker it would complete the `high` anchor with the dense fatty base (Cetearyl Alcohol @2, top three). Under an unresolved marker shea may not be credited as above-tail solely because it outranks the marker (§3.1.1 consequence 2), and the ordinal read gives it no independent support (it follows a botanical extract @7 and two mid-band oils), so `high` is withheld. `low` is unavailable on an unreadable segment and is in any case blocked by mid-band sunflower @6 / avocado @8; the value rests on the marker boundary alone, so confidence drops to `low`.
